Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Marie Manion, Arthur W. Strickler, and Jeffrey Golding, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2.Discussion about the Gay and Lesbian March on Washington COMMERCIAL:Human Rights Campaign 3.Discussion about how the press represented the Gay and Lesbian March on Washington COMMERCIAL:Village Pointe Condos 4.Andy Humm reflects upon his experience at The Names Project 5.News Watch, Philadelphia organization, [Les Femmes] falsly advertised a all lesbian cruise to Bermuda 6.Discussion about Shere Hite's book, "Woman and Love: A Cultural Revolution in Progress" 7.Announcement about Lesbian nightclub events and New York City Gay Men's Chorus Halloween Party 8.Footage from the Human Rights Campaign Dinner where Nathan Kolodor, President of Board, GMHC awarded Larry Kramer the arts award 9.Lavender Health, Footage from the film, "AIDS Changing the Rules" 10.Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1.Show Bitz, discussion about the gay play, "Farm Boys" COMMERCIAL:Gay Treasures 2.Naming Names, criticism regarding the AIDS misinformation in William F. Buckley Jr. article in The Daily News 3.Razor Sharp talks about the film "Too Outrageous," The Pyramid Club, and Halloween 4."Short Bits of Wisdom From Daddy" by Perry Brass COMMERCIAL:Village Pointe Condos 5.Rosa von Praunheim interviews Craig Russell from the film, "Too Outrageous" 6.Inside Out, Episode, "Bruce's Dungeon on the Lake." 6.Closing Credits
